Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing the state property tax levy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a reduction in the state property tax levy; andadding a new section to chapter 84.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state property tax levy for collection in 2008 shall bereduced by 14.17 percent of the levy amount that would otherwise beallowed under this chapter. (2) The state property tax levy for collection in 2009 shall bereduced by 13.85 percent of the levy amount that would otherwise beallowed under this chapter. (3) The tax reduction provided in this section is in addition toany other tax reduction legislation that may be enacted by thelegislature. (4) State levies for collection in 2010 and thereafter shall be setat the amount that would otherwise be allowed under this chapter if thestate levy for collection in 2008 and 2009 had been set without the p. 1 SB 5893reduction under subsections (1) and (2) of this section.
